### framing problem

*  dividing sequence of symbols into messages called _framing_
*  individual messages called _frames_
*  various solutions:
   *  have extra symbols for message start/end/etc.
      *  [probably most common with "fast" physical layers]{.myem-only .fragment .custom}
   *  detect electrically if transmission is happening
   *  [choose sequence of bits/bytes to represent "start message"]{.myem-only .fragment .custom}
      *  needs way of "ecsaping" those bits/bytes if they occur within message data

### spare symbols example

*  Gigabit ethernet uses scheme with 625 symbols
   *  5 amplitude levels over 4 wires
*  gives room for spare symbols for message start/end/etc.
